information_set: Frozen seasonal ledger and existing paired DC paths; no fitted coefficients, new resource forecasts or selected validation outcomes

rules.generic_realization: F=Fcap+rho*(Fpublished-Fcap); fixed rho across an entire ten-year trajectory
rules.ercot_realization: F=Fordinary_t+zeta*Fprovisional_large_load_t; published annual ordinary response retained; zeta=0 is not current_cap
rules.dc_threshold: B(L)=B_no_new-(1+mu)*(1-eta)*L, eta=Hcandidate/Lcandidate; threshold exists only if the no-new background is nonnegative and eta<1
rules.background_negative: Do not label zero as DC hosting capacity when the no-new-growth background is below reference
rules.whole_horizon_realization: Maximum of the ten annual required fractions under a single fixed response fraction
rules.timing_metric: Sum of annual positive-part native contribution requirements in GW-year, not unserved energy
rules.association: lambda is a structural association fraction, not response realization or an empirical completion probability
rules.MISO_bound: Available associated response is min(official DC path, credited total response); a feasibility bound, not a measured DC-only response increment
rules.ERCOT_bound: Available associated response is bounded by the official DC path and the increase in provisional large-load curtailment above 2025; not all large loads are DC
rules.prediction: No new prediction score or replacement of adverse historical holdout results
